William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

On Friends and Foes

[To Hunt]: ‘Madman’ I have been call’d

XXV
‘M
ADMAN’
 I have been call’d: ‘Fool’ they call thee.
I wonder which they envy — thee or me?
